integrity: The cellular model, boundary ranks, full 120-element automorphism action, character values, and irreducible decompositions are reconstructed by the bundled verifier. A 36-vector integral kernel certificate supplies an exact rational-rank upper bound and exact homology traces; finite computation is the proof for this finite graph and is not extrapolated to a family.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two unordered particles on the dodecahedral graph, with rational homology and the induced full graph-automorphism action; no integral lattice decomposition or uniform Platonic-family theorem is claimed.
title: Dodecahedral two-point configuration homology as an \(A_5\times C_2\)-module
